verdict.rationale: Attio's REST API docs describe webhooks that subscribe to changes in Attio and send real-time HTTP requests to a chosen target URL. Every webhook request is cryptographically signed with the webhook secret in an Attio-Signature header. A dedicated webhooks guide sits in the official docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detail on the event-type catalog and retry/delivery semantics.
